title: Permissions & data
intro: What gpm accesses on your device, why it's needed, and where to change it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Shows a sticky notification while a password is on the clipboard so you can clear it early.

biometric.title: Biometric unlock
biometric.body: Unlock gpm with your fingerprint or face instead of your passphrase.
biometric.noEnrollment: Not enrolled — tap to set up
biometric.weakEnrolled: Class 3 needed — tap to set up

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.body: Copies a password to the clipboard so you can paste it elsewhere; auto-clears after the timeout. Android provides no separate permission for this.

network.title: Network
network.body: Connects only to the git remotes you configure for sync — never to gpm's servers.

files.title: Files
files.body: Reads a file only when you choose one (e.g. importing an identity); it never scans your storage.
